title: Read Only Total
statement: Implement `solve(prices, assign)`. `prices` is a list of integers. The total is their sum. `assign` is the string `none` when nobody assigns to the total, or `set` when they try. Return the sum when `assign` is `none`. Return `error` when they try to set the total. Do not change the prices.
hints: If assign is set, return error instead of the sum.
An empty price list sums to 0.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A property without a setter raises on assignment.

editorial: A property without a setter raises on assignment. The total is computed from the items, so storing it would drift. The set flag is the assignment attempt. The sum is the only legal read.
